# FunnyBytes

**Author:** Lucifer_forever<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![FunnyBytes: screenshot 1](./funnybytes/img/funnybytes.png)

</div>

FunnyBytes localizes the FullFlash of Siemens C35, M35, and S35 into Russian. The program automatically detects the firmware version, edits Russian SMS messages and the keyboard layout, enables NetMonitor, switches the GSM 900/1800 band, disables CRC checking, and disables automatic switching with `*`.
